t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They said that tall hats were a good thing to look out for and that I should change choices to get an idea which colours and sizes payout. The said to not forget the spacebar.

vb_textbox.text: I wracked my brain with this one but unfortunately I don't know exactly what the trick is with this, but I do have a few thoughts. I don't think it is as simple as the tall hatted gnomes give higher numbers of mushrooms than shorter ones(or vice versa), I also don't think it's a case of certain colours give more than others. My instinct is that it is some sort of pattern but what that pattern is I just don't know. Good luck and I hope you do well.
